news.Title: If You'd Invested $10,000 in Tesla a Decade Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today
news.Content:
In the past decade, few stocks have delivered life-changing returns like Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA). If you had bought $10,000 in Tesla stock 10 years ago, that investment would be worth a staggering $217,900 today.

With CEO Elon Musk at the helm, the company has achieved impressive scale that has historically hounded upstart automakers and has evolved into a speculative play on self-driving vehicles, energy, and other emerging technologies. Here's what has driven Tesla's growth and what investors have to look forward to.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Tesla's scaled electric vehicle business sent the stock soaring in the past decade

Tesla bucked the traditional automotive industry business model with direct-to-consumer sales, bypassing dealerships and giving the company full control over its customer buying experience. Its vertical integration helped lower assembly costs and gave it a gross margin that crushed industry peers in the early 2020s.

Over the years, Tesla did an exceptional job scaling its manufacturing capabilities, starting with key expansions in Fremont and Shanghai. This growth, coupled with strong tailwinds from regulatory credit sales, helped Tesla turn cash-flow positive and GAAP (generally accepted accounting principles) profitable, sending the stock soaring and earning it a spot in the S&P 500 index in late 2020.

Here's what could drive Tesla's growth over the next decade

While Tesla has done an excellent job scaling up its EV business, the company looks to achieve more technological breakthroughs under Musk, which is why it trades at such a lofty valuation.

The automaker continues to develop its end-to-end self-driving software and build out its ride-hailing network infrastructure and dedicated autonomous vehicle platform, which could open up high-margin recurring software revenue through subscriptions or other offerings.

Additionally, it is leveraging its battery manufacturing footprint to expand its Megapack and Powerwall offerings, which can address the power needs for utility, industrial, and data center operators . These battery storage systems could prove hugely useful in helping utilities stabilize intermittent renewable power grids.

Meanwhile, its Optimus robot is another moonshot project that could eventually account for a majority of Tesla's long-term value, according to Musk. These general-purpose robots are an idea straight out of science fiction, and could revolutionize and serve a wide range of purposes for both business and personal use.

Story Continues

Is Tesla stock a buy?

Analysts project Tesla's earnings to grow at a 24% compound annual rate from 2025 through 2028. With 2028 non-GAAP earnings per share projected at $3.17, the stock is priced at 100 times those projected earnings, well above the automotive sector and far outpacing major technology stocks.

That said, Tesla investors buying the company today are betting it can achieve huge technological and business breakthroughs with its self-driving vehicles, batteries, and Optimus robots. If Musk succeeds in one or more of these areas, it could send earnings projections higher and set the stage for large returns further down the road.

Ever feel like you missed the boat in buying the most successful stocks? Then you'll want to hear this.

On rare occasions, our expert team of analysts issues a "Double Down" stock recommendation for companies that they think are about to pop. If you're worried you've already missed your chance to invest, now is the best time to buy before it's too late. And the numbers speak for themselves:

Apple: if you invested $1,000 when we doubled down in 2008, you'd have $59,719 !*

Netflix: if you invested $1,000 when we doubled down in 2004, you'd have $399,832 !*

news.Title: SK海力士砸54.3兆韓元擴產，KOSPI週一彈升0.65%、KOSDAQ飆6.97%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】標普500指數上週五(7日)刷新收盤新高，為韓股週一止瀉提供底氣。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)高開高走，開盤約10分鐘大漲2.2%，觸及6,394.06點日高；其後電子股衝高回落，指數一度翻黑至6,232.45點日低，終場在醫療與精密設備、鋼鐵、機械及運輸設備類股接棒走強下，倒升40.89點或0.65%，收在6,299.66點，扭轉前兩個交易日累跌5.18%的弱勢。同日，以科技與中小型股為主的KOSDAQ指數狂飆55.66點或6.97%，收在854.47點，盤中一度觸發韓國交易所SIDECAR機制，暫停程式化買盤。KOSPI早盤漲幅明顯收斂，顯示大型電子權值股上方賣壓仍重；相較之下，資金加速回補先前跌幅較深的中小型成長股，使兩大指數表現明顯分化。

韓國記憶體大廠SK海力士(SK hynix，韓股代碼000660，美股代碼SKHY)宣布，將在韓國投入合計54.3兆韓元(約380億美元)，擴建DRAM與NAND快閃記憶體產能。其中，龍仁半導體聚落第二階段晶圓廠投資35.2兆韓元，主要生產高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及次世代DRAM，首座無塵室預計2029年6月啟用；第一階段晶圓廠首座無塵室則預定明年2月投入使用。清州M17晶圓廠另投資19.1兆韓元，首座無塵室預計2028年12月啟用，整體投資於2031年前完成，並可依AI伺服器、數據中心及企業級儲存需求彈性調整產品配置。SK海力士終場收小黑跌0.14%，三星電子也小跌0.43%，系出同門的三星電管則急彈4.9%，成為三十檔大型股(KTOP30)第三旺個股，只輸給未來資產大宇和韓華航空航天，兩者各飆漲7.37%和5.01%。

不過，韓股中期資金壓力尚未解除。KOSPI上週再跌逾6%，連續第七週收黑，創2022年12月以來最長週線連跌紀錄，自6月高點迄今已回落約33%；三星電子與SK海力士占這波KOSPI市值蒸發約2,257.8兆韓元的76%。與此同時，韓國散戶7月淨買入美股46億美元，創六個月新高，且自2月以來首次超越對韓股的買入力道。美銀警告，若韓股持續落後美股，散戶海外投資可能再度加速，使近期受SK海力士海外籌資匯回款支撐的韓元，後續維持升勢的空間更加有限。

news.Title: 外資上週加碼台股266億！ 緯創買最多「這檔」最慘被砍12.7萬張
news.Content:
外資單週狂吸266.9億元！緯創豪奪買超王、聯電遭重砍12.7萬張淪賣超首位。

外資單週回補266億

根據證交易所最新統計，上週（115/8/3~115/8/7）外資在集中市場總買進金額為19,964.25億元，總賣出金額為19,697.35億元，買超金額達266.90億元。自115年年初至8月7日止，外資總買進金額累計為53兆1,846.74億元，總賣出金額為54兆8,480.65億元，累計賣超幅度降至16,633.91億元。

外資持股市值突破69兆

在整體持股比重方面，外資總持有股票（包含原始股東持股及自集中市場買進之持股）市值達到69兆6,082.44億元新台幣，佔全體上市股票總市值的48.20%。相較於7月31日的68兆8,591.39億元新台幣，外資總持股市值在短短一週內大幅增加了7,491.05億元新台幣。

緯創登頂買超三強

進一步分析上週個股買超表現，緯創以買進284,712張、賣出209,638張，買超75,074張（7.51萬張）高居買超第一名；長榮航以買進130,777張、賣出58,405張，買超72,372張位居第二；鴻海則以買進161,205張、賣出95,545張，買超65,660張排名第三。

聯電遭賣超逾12萬張

賣超個股部分，聯電遭外資大量調節，上週買進394,119張、賣出521,746張，賣超高達127,627張（12.76萬張），成為賣超最多的上市公司；臺企銀以買進58,112張、賣出179,391張，賣超121,279張位居第二；第一金則以買進83,684張、賣出172,352張，賣超88,668張名列賣超第三名。

news.Title: 台積電7月營收再創歷史新高　台股盤中收復4萬5千點、收盤大漲702點
news.Content:
台積電 7 月合併營收約為新台幣 4,675 億 8,000 萬元，，創下單月營收歷史新高。累計 今年 1 至 7 月營收約為新台幣 2 兆8千多億元。（攝影／鄭國強）

台積電（2330）（10）日收盤後公佈7月營收報告。2026年 7 月合併營收約為新台幣 4,675 億 8,000 萬元，較去年同期增加了 44.7％，創下單月營收歷史新高。累計 今年 1 至 7 月營收約為新台幣 2 兆8,720億6,400萬元，較去年同期增加了 37.0％。

雖然台積電是在台股收盤後公布，但台股已經提前慶祝，台積電收盤上漲10元，收在2380元，已經站上月線 10日均線 5日均線，也帶動台股收盤大漲，盤中還一度漲上45219.4點，最後收盤上漲702.85點，收在44928.76點，成交量8474億元。

權值股全面上揚，台達電（2308）亮燈漲停，收在1815元，收復1755元到1635元的空方缺口。聯發科（2454）上漲1.54%，收在3960元。鴻海（2317）漲1.73%，收在264.5元，連續第四天在季線和月均線之上。日月光（3711）大漲7.69%，收在630元，是上週主動式ETF買超最多的權值股，買超2000張以上。

主動式ETF的最愛持股台光電（2383）也小漲0.95%，收在5290元。台光電其實在8月4日收復季線和月線，反彈到5140元以後，已經連續第五天在5140元以上。

投資人最津津樂道的是記憶體族群大復活，主要記憶體股就有南亞科（2408）、旺宏（2337）、華邦電（2344）亮燈漲停，南亞科收在502元、事隔一個半月，幾乎快要攻回6月22日歷史高點505元，旺宏收在133.5元、華邦電收在179.5元。

其他群聯（8299）也上漲0.99%，收在2040元，力積電（6770）則上漲3.21%收在67.6元，回到7月22日的價位。

矽光子族群也相當強勢，聯亞（3081）收在漲停價2535元，華星光（4979）也亮燈漲停在536元，波若威（3163）大漲5.22%，收在706元，汎銓（6830）也大漲6.66%，收在424.5元。

(原始連結)

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股上漲702點收44928點　收復季線44331點
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱台北2026年8月10日電）美國7月非農就業人數意外減少，市場對聯準會升息預期降低，資金重回科技股，台股今天開高震盪，台積電尾盤股價漲勢收斂，集中市場指數終場上漲702.85點，收在44928.76點，重新站上季線44331點，成交值新台幣8473.72億元。

權值股台積電 (2330) 今天盤中股價最多上漲40元至2410元，但尾盤壓回，終場上漲10元，收在全日最低點2380元；聯發科 (2454) 漲60元或1.54%，收3960元；台達電 (2308) 攻上漲停板1815元，上漲165元，股價創兩週來高點。

市場傳出台積電有意購入友達中科L7廠與L5C廠，擴充先進封裝產能，未來可能比照「群創模式」合作發展先進封裝技術。受此激勵，面板雙虎友達 (2409) 、群創 (3481) 今天雙雙爆出逾21萬張大量，股價攻上漲停板27元及52.3元。

「萬金股」川湖 (2059) 上週公布財報亮眼，今天股價續強，開盤再度亮燈漲停，最高衝上12220元，終場上漲795元或7.16%，以11905元作收，穩居股后。

富邦投顧董事長陳奕光分析，台股7月下旬回檔修正，但AI道路趨勢並沒有改變，變的是資金籌碼，7月29日FOMC（聯邦公開市場委員會）維持利率不變，但有3位票委支持升息1碼，他認為到9月下次利率會議前，這份報告會一直影響市場。

不過陳奕光認為，美國聯準會今年升息機會不高，明年甚至有機會偏向降息，有利台股後勢。富邦投顧內部評估，市場預期造成利率自行上升，已提供部分緊縮效果，顯示市場不再完全依賴聯準會。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: Prediction: Sandisk Will Reclaim Its All-Time High by the End of the Year
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) is one of the only growth stocks that can more than quadruple and still be undervalued. Superb fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter results and broader memory chip trends suggest that Sandisk can reclaim its all-time high of just above $2,350 per share.

The stock would almost have to double from its current price to reach that level. Although it may sound difficult to imagine that type of growth, given Sandisk's recent returns, it's entirely feasible.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Sandisk has the growth numbers of a giant

It's no secret that Sandisk is posting high revenue growth rates, but it truly is on a different level from other chipmakers and tech leaders. Sandisk told investors in its fiscal 2026 third quarter to expect up to $8.25 billion in revenue for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter, which ended July 3. When the Q4 press release arrived, Sandisk reported $8.97 billion in revenue.

That's a 51% sequential improvement, and guidance for its fiscal 2027 first quarter implies up to $10.8 billion in revenue. That suggests a 20% sequential growth rate.

That growth is moving full steam ahead with superb profit margins. Generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) net income reached $6.9 billion, which exceeded the company's fiscal 2026 third-quarter revenue.

All of these numbers are incredible. Not even Micron (NASDAQ: MU) is growing this quickly. Sandisk CEO David Goeckeler emphasized in the earnings release that the company is positioned to "generate growing and durable free cash flow." That doesn't sound like a business that is slowing down anytime soon.

Sandisk's valuation cannot stay this low forever

Continuing this fundamental overview of the stock, Sandisk's recent pullback has put its forward price-to-earnings ratio below 20. That provides a higher margin of safety for new investors, and it also makes Sandisk cheaper than most tech giants.

Amazon trades at a 30 forward P/E ratio, while Nvidia and Broadcom have forward P/E ratios of 23 and 21, respectively. None of them is growing as quickly as Sandisk, even though all three are well-positioned for rising AI demand.

Investors bid Sandisk up to a little above $2,350 because they were excited about the fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter guidance. Now, the stock has taken a massive haircut after the company blew past its quarterly expectations and set ambitious first-quarter targets.

Story Continues

The memory chip boom isn't fading anytime soon

The only possible way to view Sandisk in a bearish light is if you believe memory chip prices will eventually crash due to an inventory glut, especially if hyperscalers cut back on AI spending. However, there are no signs that point to that unlikely scenario.

Space Exploration Technologies expects to deliver up to 20 gigawatts of compute capacity by the end of 2027. Meta Platforms intends to build tens of gigawatts this decade and hundreds of gigawatts over time. That's just two hyperscalers, and they all need a lot of memory chips to reach their lofty goals.

Capital expenditure targets for tech companies continue to climb, and high revenue growth for various cloud platforms suggests that AI spending will continue to ramp up. If there were a real risk of a slowdown in capital expenditure, some caution would be warranted.

However, chipmakers and hyperscalers are both pointing to continued growth. Sandisk and its fellow chipmakers forecast meaningful growth in their upcoming quarters. It's not just memory chipmakers, either. Nvidia and Broadcom both projected solid growth rates for their upcoming quarters. Tech giants continue to accelerate market share gains with the help of AI.

Sandisk's recent pullback has more to do with its one-year return than its fundamentals. Many investors think it is natural for a stock to enter a deep correction after surging in a short amount of time. That consensus is misguided for Sandisk, and the chipmaker may be due for an all-time high by the end of the year.

news.Title: 2奈米量產＋3奈米與先進封裝供不應求，台積電7月營收再創新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】受惠於先進製程與先進封裝供不應求，尤其2奈米量產，加上3奈米產出增加，晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330)7月營收創單月歷史新高。而台積電先前預期第三季營收季增率約一成多，也二度上修全年營收展望。台積電今日公佈2026年7月成績單，7月合併營收約為4,675億8,000萬元，較6月增加了5.6%，也比去年同期增加了44.7%，再創單月歷史新高。累計台積電今年1到7月營收約為2兆8,720億6,400萬元，較去年同期增加了37.0%。

依據台積電先前公布的第三季財測，單季營收目標446億至458億美元，以1美元兌換32元新台幣，第三季營收將為1.43兆至1.47兆元，季增約一成多，但單季毛利率預估為65%至67%，較第二季的高點67.7%小幅下滑，主因2奈米進入量產爬坡期，與海外晶圓廠擴產帶來的初期成本影響。而台積電也二度上修全年展望，全年美元營收成長預估，預計年增將略高於40%。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》ASIC與GPU的競合—AVGO、NVDA、MRVL
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 14:04:18 數位內容中心 發佈

Broadcom（AVGO.US）

8月資料顯示，Broadcom把ASIC切入點放在大型雲端服務商自研晶片供應鏈。2026會計年度第2季AI半導體營收為108億美元，AI訂單金額超過300億美元，且公司指引第3季AI營收將達160億美元，反映客製化ASIC已開始分食AI基礎設施預算。

NVIDIA（NVDA.US）

近期NVIDIA把競爭焦點從單顆GPU拉高到整個AI factory平台。Blackwell GB300已於第2季開始出貨，產能約為每週1000個機櫃；GB300 NVL72在推理場景相較Hopper可帶來50倍每token能效提升，並由機櫃與互連共同支撐平台銷售。

Marvell（MRVL.US）

近期Marvell釋出的關鍵訊號，是hyperscaler客製化ASIC專案已進入較長的收入堆疊期。公司指出新拿下的design win，通常需12至24個月才會進入量產與明顯營收貢獻，顯示ASIC外包已從概念驗證走向多年期供貨節奏。

MediaTek

近期MediaTek明確把AI資料中心ASIC列為新成長主軸。董事會已核准籌措50億美元資金以確保供應鏈產能，首個ASIC產品家族正與美國大型雲端服務供應商合作開發，預計於2026年第4季投產，並預估2026年相關營收將超過20億美元。

Anthropic

近期Anthropic確認建立自研晶片設計團隊，將為Claude模型開發客製化晶片，同時強調這是multi-chip strategy，不會取代既有NVIDIA、AMD、AWS與Google Cloud合作。原始資料並指出，先進AI處理器在製造前的設計成本約為5億美元。

Synopsys（SNPS.US）

近期Kimi K3事件把ASIC設計工具門檻推上檯面，也直接牽動Synopsys股價。原始資料指出，該示範僅用開源工具與45nm academic library完成4平方毫米晶片設計，未使用Synopsys產品。

news.Title: Iran Tensions Highlight Defense Supply Gaps Poised to Lift 2 Stocks
news.Content:
When shipping lanes around Iran become combat zones, the world is reminded that modern militaries still run on some very old fundamentals: munitions, sensors, and logistics. Recent attacks and closures in the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea have underscored how thin global defense supply has become, especially for drones, precision weapons, and artillery shells.

That stress does not just move oil prices. It can reshape the outlook for a handful of defense contractors that have been quietly scaling up for exactly this kind of environment.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. AeroVironment: Filling the small‑drone gap

If you watch footage from contested regions, you see many small, lethal drones. AeroVironment (NASDAQ: AVAV) is one of the companies behind that reality. In February 2026, the company announced a $186 million U.S. Army order for its Switchblade 600 Block 2 and Switchblade 300 Block 20 loitering munitions, under a five‑year contract with a $990 million ceiling, first awarded in 2024. These systems are designed to let small units destroy armored vehicles and key targets without calling in larger missiles or aircraft.

For investors, that tells you two things. First, the U.S. is not treating loitering munitions as a niche experiment. The Army is rolling them into its core toolkit with multiyear funding and export support to allies. Second, AeroVironment is now on the hook to deliver at scale, which can deepen customer relationships but also test its own supply chain and manufacturing. The upside is clear in an era when U.S. Central Command talks about nightly drone and missile strikes around Hormuz and the Red Sea. The risk is that any production stumble or integration delay could sour confidence at a time when demand is hot, and alternatives are emerging.

2. L3Harris: Sensors, communications, and missile capacity

Where AeroVironment focuses on the trigger, L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) helps militaries see, talk, and coordinate. Its latest results show a company already busy trying to close some of the supply gaps that current tensions have exposed. In the first quarter of 2026, L3Harris reported orders of $7.8 billion and a book‑to‑bill ratio of 1.4, pushing backlog to a record $40.7 billion. By the second quarter, backlog had climbed again to $42 billion on $7.3 billion of new orders and an 8% revenue increase to $5.9 billion.

Story Continues

Behind those numbers is a lot of hardware. In its annual report, L3Harris outlined roughly $2 billion in commitments to expand missile production capacity, including facilities, equipment, and supply chain upgrades. That is not just about more weapons. It is about hardening the industrial base so that when corners of the world flare, commanders are not told the shelves are empty. I see that as a quiet but important response to what we are watching in the Gulf: sustained operations draining inventories faster than factories can refill them.

The downside here is similar to other defense primes. Large backlogs can tempt management into overpromising, and missile programs are politically sensitive. Budget cycles, elections, and shifting threat perceptions can all slow or reroute planned spending even when the underlying need looks obvious.

What this means for investors

To me, these two companies sit at key choke points in the defense supply chain that current tensions with Iran have brought into relief: AeroVironment in small precision-strike systems and L3Harris in communications and missile capabilities. Neither of them is a pure bet on a single conflict. Their contracts and backlogs stretch across multiple theaters and customers.

That is the good news. The harder part is sizing any investment. These stocks can benefit from heightened tensions, but they also ride political cycles, budget arguments, and long procurement timelines. If you are looking to express a view that defense supply gaps exposed in Hormuz and the Red Sea will finally push governments to pay up for munitions, sensors, and shells, these names belong on the watch list. Just make sure they sit within a broader portfolio, not as your only bet on a world that feels less stable by the week.

news.Title: 太猛了！台積電7月營收衝破4675億、年增44.7％ 再創歷史新高
news.Content:
台積電今（10）日公布2026年7月營收報告，2026年7月合併營收約新台幣4675億8000萬元，較上月增加5.6%，較去年同期增加44.7%，再度刷新單月歷史新高紀錄。

台積電累計2026年1至7月營收約為新台幣2兆8720億6400萬元，同樣也是史上最高，較去年同期增加37.0%。

台積電董事長魏哲家先前在法說會中預估，第三季美元營收約介於446億至458億美元之間；以1美元兌換32元新台幣的匯率估算，折合新台幣營收約1兆4272億元至1兆4656億元之間。

從營收推進速度來看，台積電7月營收達4675.8億元，已達成第3季財測目標的3成以上；魏哲家日前在法說會中指出，受惠主要客戶對3奈米與5奈米等先進製程需求熱絡，以及先進封裝產能供不應求，公司已上修2026全年美元營收目標，由原先預期的年增30％以上，進一步調升至略高於40％。

此外，台積電預估第3季毛利率將落在65％至67％之間，營益率則介於56％至58％。隨著下半年消費性電子迎接備貨旺季，加上AI伺服器供應鏈拉貨力道延續，先進製程產能利用率可望維持高檔運作。

台積電今股價一度反攻至2410元，終場漲10元收2380元，漲幅0.42%。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》先進封裝—TSM、LRCX、AMKR
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 13:49:15 數位內容中心 發佈

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited（TSM.US）

8月6日市場消息指出，台積電為配合蘋果A20 Pro量產，2奈米製程進展順利，但約10億美元處理器仍待DRAM到貨後才能完成封裝。公司同時導入被描述為「行動版CoWoS」的新封裝，將高階邏輯與標準化DRAM整合至同一封裝。

Intel Corporation（INTC.US）

8月5日產業消息顯示，英特爾於7月底與Fortinet達成策略合作，開發採小晶片異質整合設計的SP6，並使用英特爾4奈米級製程與嵌入式多晶片互連橋接（EMIB）2.5D先進封裝。這也是英特爾4奈米製程首度公開對外簽約商業客戶。

Amkor Technology, Inc.（AMKR.US）

NVIDIA與Amkor簽署多年期協議，預付15億美元擴充美國先進封裝與測試產能，重點落在亞利桑那州。這筆預付款將錨定於Amkor在當地興建中的70億美元製造園區，並銜接其與台積電6月建立的10年期美國封裝合作。

Lam Research Corporation（LRCX.US）

Lam Research表示，2026年先進封裝營收預計年增超過70%，需求來自HBM與2.5D/3D類封裝。公司並已將510x515毫米面板系統出貨至多個地區開發計畫，且將於今年出貨首台310x310毫米面板工具。

Applied Materials, Inc.（AMAT.US）

市場消息顯示，Applied Materials的先進封裝相關營收在2026年預估將成長超過50%。管理層並指出，半導體設備業務在2026日曆年預計成長超過30%，顯示先進封裝已成為公司當年前進的重要成長來源之一。

KLA Corporation（KLAC.US）

近期市場彙整指出，KLA預期2026年先進封裝營收將大增超過70%，先進封裝製程控制營收可望超過11億美元。公司並表示，為因應更強需求情境，已增加長交期零組件的採購承諾，以保留供應彈性。

Onto Innovation Inc.（ONTO.US）

8月5日市場資訊顯示，Onto Innovation預期2026年先進封裝營收成長超過50%，其Dragonfly G5已在2.5D邏輯客戶完成資格驗證。這代表先進封裝量測與檢測設備已推進至正式驗證里程碑，對後續裝機與出貨形成直接訊號。

news.Title: 電子權值股領軍上攻，指數攻克季線
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃俊超】美股上週五道瓊上漲0.28%、S&P500上漲0.62%、Nasdaq上漲1.3%、費城半導體上漲2.56%。道瓊與S&P500在創高軌道上，Nasdaq也逼近歷史高點，費城半導體則延續反彈，試圖挑戰60日均線。日經指數週一上漲突破60日均線，延續反彈攻勢，要留意的是日圓匯率的變動，主要是美國與日本政府未來可能執行的政策，韓國綜合指數近期相對沉寂，持穩於短期均線，試圖突破20日均線反壓，重點仍在三星電子與SK海力士兩大權值股，能否出現突破性的表現。中國上證指數延續反彈，短中長期均線趨於糾結，香港恆生指數在240日均線附近震盪，約在前波整理平台區間內。美元指數99~100，新台幣32~32.5，日圓156~159。

加權指數週一開高走高，終場上漲702.85點、1.59%，收在44928.76點，成交量為8473.72億元，跳空站上60日均線，延續反彈格局，不過成交量仍是低於近期均量，60日均線走平，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸，日MACD指標紅色柱狀體增加。可留意營運持續成長且估值相對不高的個股，歷經籌碼清洗浮額，第二季財報搭配修正後的本益比，將成為盤面選股的方向依據。

櫃檯指數隨加權指數波動，終場上漲7.42點、1.93%，收在391.61點，成交量為1928.4億元，依舊持穩在5日均線之上，或將續勢挑戰60日均線，反彈有利逐漸緩解20日與60日均線下彎狀況，不過20日均線向下交叉60日均線，仍需等待時間化解，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸，日MACD指標紅色柱狀體增加，以高價股為指標。

台積電(2330)漲0.42%、維持在所有均線之上，聯發科(2454)漲1.54%、在5日與60日均線附近，台達電(2308)漲停板、鴻海(2317)漲1.73%、日月光投控(3711)漲7.69%，另外包含光寶科(2301)、華邦電(2344)與南亞科(2408)攻上漲停板，川湖(2059)、國巨(2327)、聯電(2303)、研華(2395)、廣達(2382)與緯創(3231)漲幅超過5%。傳產股與生技股主要偏重於個股表現，尤其財報表現相對佳，且基期仍屬偏低的個股。

news.Title: 無法站上45K！台股收漲702點 台積電尾盤遭甩賣
news.Content:
台股今（10日）開高走高，盤中一度大漲將近千點，強勢站上45200點關卡，隨後漲幅略微收斂，終場仍上漲702.85點，收在44928.76點，權值股台積電一度上漲40元，尾盤遭甩賣最終僅漲10元，收在2380元，台達電飆上漲停鎖在1815元，聯發科漲60元收在3960元，鴻海也同步上漲逾1%。

熱門族群記憶體、面板、被動元件及矽光子等全面噴出，南亞科、旺宏、鈺創與華邦電攻上漲停，國巨大漲逾5%，禾伸堂強鎖漲停，日電貿也大漲逾6%，PCB三雄也有所表現，南電強漲5%，欣興漲逾3%，景碩也出現超過1%的漲幅，面板三雄友達、群創及彩晶同步漲停。

由於美國7月非農就業數據意外衰退，使市場對聯準會後續升息預期降溫，刺激美股大漲，亞洲股市也受惠強漲。分析師林漢偉指出，科技股與半導體股全面走強，標普500指數收盤再創歷史新高，半導體族群單周更大漲近10%，顯示資金重新回流AI與科技成長股。

針對台股後市，林漢偉提到，台股挑戰反彈新高，反映升息預期降溫利多，電子權值股買盤回流，中小型股則觀察主流族群表態力道。短線指數反彈幅度擴大，操作重點仍是量能與法人資金是否持續回補。

台股上周五（7日）下跌170.79點，收在44225.91點，成交值8192.04億元。三大法人合計賣超442.44億元。自營商賣超9.68億元，投信賣超25.6億元，外資及陸資賣超407.16億元。

news.Title: 台積電7月營收衝至4675.8億　創歷史新高
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年08月10日電）台積電 (2330) 自結7月營收新台幣4675.8億元，再創歷史新高，較6月增加5.6%，較去年同期增加44.7%。法人指出，2奈米等先進製程需求強勁，是推升7月營收創高的主要動力。

台積電累計前7月營收達2兆8720.64億元，較去年同期增加37%。

台積電預估，第3季美元營收將約446億至458億美元，假設平均匯率為1美元兌新台幣32元。推估台積電8、9月平均單月營收將約4798.1億至4990.1億元，可望續創歷史新高。

受惠人工智慧（AI）相關需求強勁，台積電預期，2026年美元營收增幅可望微幅超越40%。因應客戶強勁需求，台積電2026年資本支出將達到600億至640億美元。

news.Title: 財報行情撐場 全球股票基金連11週淨流入
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 13:37:09 李彥瑾 發佈

全球企業接連交出亮眼財報，加上國際原油價格回落，帶動投資人風險胃納提升。根據倫敦證交所集團（LSEG）旗下Lipper統計，截至8月5日止當週，全球股票型基金淨流入211.5億美元，雖低於前週的277.2億美元，但已連續11週吸金，顯示市場資金動能仍相當強勁。

路透社報導，近期多家重量級企業財報報喜，包括亞馬遜（Amazon）、開拓重工（Caterpillar）與Palantir均釋出優於預期的成績單，大幅提振市場信心。截至目前已公布財報的808檔MSCI世界指數成分股中，上季獲利合計年增40.9%，其中高達75%超越分析師預期。

知名大型雲端業者持續加碼AI基建支出，也成為推升美股企業獲利的重要引擎。高盛預估，Alphabet、微軟、亞馬遜、Meta與甲骨文今年資本支出合計將逼近8,000億美元。科技巨頭最新財報顯示，雲端與AI投資已開始產生回報，市場對AI資本支出降溫的疑慮也隨之減輕。

從資金流向來看，歐洲股票型基金單週吸金125.2億美元，創7月8日以來最大流入；亞洲股票型基金亦獲淨流入81.5億美元。相較之下，美國股票型基金遭撤資15.8億美元，主因美股創新高引發獲利了結賣壓，加上投資人等待7月非農報告以釐清聯準會（Fed）利率走向，資金暫時轉為觀望。

債市同樣維持吸金力道，上週全球債券型基金累計淨流入122.7億美元，創近三週新高，其中高收益債基金吸金36.6億美元，寫下五週最大單週流入。

news.Title: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Has Refused to Give Forward Guidance for 2 Straight Meetings. Here's Why That Should Worry Markets.
news.Content:
If you ever have to deliver bad news to someone, it's almost always a good idea to signal in advance that bad news is coming.

This can be as simple as starting with "I'm afraid I have some bad news for you..." or adopting a serious tone of voice or facial expression. These cues help the listener to emotionally prepare themselves for what's coming.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The Federal Reserve used to do something similar with monetary policy, offering forward guidance on what to expect at its next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, where benchmark interest rates are set. But new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has rejected that practice, refusing to offer any indications at all about where interest rates might be heading.

Here's why that should worry markets and investors.

Brace yourself

Markets hate uncertainty, and many of the biggest one-day market moves in history have been prompted by FOMC meetings. But big one-day sell-offs are a shock to unprepared markets and can trigger cascading aftershocks .

Past Fed chairs, including Warsh's immediate predecessor, Jerome Powell, used forward guidance and carefully crafted language to signal the direction markets could expect interest rates to move at future meetings. That forward guidance helped give markets time to prepare for upcoming rate hikes. It could also help to mute the market's reaction to an unexpected decision by allowing the Fed to signal that a desired outcome might occur soon.

But Warsh believes this kind of signaling has two big drawbacks.

Why Warsh won't provide guidance

First, Warsh thinks that when the Fed offers clues about its likely next move, it interferes with the market's efficiency. He recently explained: "I think financial markets perform best when they react to incoming data. I think the financial markets work less efficiently when they ask [the] question: 'How will the Federal Reserve react?'" In other words, Warsh believes that forward guidance substitutes the Fed's interpretation of economic data for the data itself.

Second, Warsh believes that the Fed may feel compelled to honor its forward guidance to avoid upsetting markets, even if newer data conflicts with that guidance. Warsh claims such concerns don't hamstring his FOMC. "I think my colleagues ... understand the world is changing quite quickly," he said. "And they [won't] feel bound by [their current predictions] six weeks from now or six days from now in the event that their circumstances change."

Story Continues

What's likely to happen

While Warsh's objections are logical, they ignore a simple fact: Even if the Fed offers no guidance, the markets aren't going to stop trying to guess its next move.

For example, after Warsh's most recent press conference, where he offered no clues about how the Fed might act to curb inflation, bond markets interpreted his silence as meaning the Fed wouldn't take any action at all. That triggered a steep bond sell-off that spilled over into the stock market, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES: ^DJI) down 840 points.

That 840-point drop could be nothing compared to the impact on the S&P 500 if the markets expect a rate cut but get a rate increase, or vice versa. Investors should be prepared for increased market volatility around FOMC meetings as long as Warsh maintains this new policy.

news.Title: Sony/台積電傳砸"1兆" 29年量產次世代影像感測器
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 13:10:02 蔡承啟 發佈

影像感測器龍頭廠Sony和台灣台積電(2330)傳出將砸1兆日圓，目標在2029年於熊本縣量產次世代影像感測器。

日經新聞10日報導 ，Sony、台積電將在2029年於熊本縣量產次世代影像感測器，將由Sony出資約60%、台積電出資約40%的合資公司負責生產，總投資額預估達1兆日圓。Sony、台積電已在今年5月簽署了不具約束力的合作備忘錄，將攜手研發、生產次世代影像感測器，而預估雙方將在近期內就上述量產投資達成共識，在2026年度內設立合資公司。

報導指出，合資公司將在Sony旗下子公司「索尼半導體解決方案(Sony Semiconductor Solutions)」位於熊本縣合志市的影像感測器工廠內設置大規模研發設備及產線，目標3年後導入量產，且正與經濟產業省協商補助金事宜。

據報導，合資公司的投資額達1兆日圓，相當於Sony半導體部門4年的設備投資額，接近台積電熊本第1工廠的總投資額86億美元(約1.35兆日圓)。合資公司預估將供應高性能相機感測器給蘋果(Apple)iPhone使用，未來也著眼於實體AI(Physical AI)領域的應用。

報導指出，一直以來雙方是採取分工模式，感測器部分由Sony研發量產、運算處理部分則委由台積電代工，此次藉由合資公司攜手進行生產，藉此因應AI普及所帶動的需求成長。Sony是台積電於日本市場的主要客戶，Sony也有對台積電熊本工廠進行出資。

根據調查公司Techno Systems Research指出，2025年全球CMOS影像感測器市場規模為225億美元，其中Sony橫掃53.6%市佔率、高居首位，其次依序為OMNIVISION的13.4%、三星電子的13.2%。

news.Title: Forget Chips: AI Is Now a Power Trade. These 2 Dividend-Paying Industrials Prove It.
news.Content:
Data centers that use artificial intelligence (AI) all need one thing -- a steady power supply. That's where NextEra Energy (NYSE: NEE) and Oneok (NYSE: OKE), companies that can deliver dependable energy, come in.

NextEra Energy is the largest publicly traded electric utility by market capitalization, valued at more than $178 billion. It is a hybrid utility that mixes regulated stability with aggressive clean-energy growth.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Midstream operator Oneok has more than 60,000 miles of pipelines that deliver natural gas and crude oil. Its earnings per share (EPS) compound annual growth rate is 13% over the past decade.

As a bonus, both companies offer attractive dividend yields and a history of dividend growth. Here's why I like each of these stocks.

NextEra's huge size and scope give it plenty of options

NextEra operates through two complementary divisions that mitigate downside risk while capturing upside growth: Florida Power & Light, which benefits from strong population growth in Florida and has dependable rate-base-driven revenue and earnings growth; and NextEra Energy Resources, a global leader in wind, solar, and battery storage development. This unregulated competitive energy segment provides a growth multiplier that traditional utilities cannot match.

The company will get even bigger if its proposed $67 billion all-stock merger with Dominion Energy goes through, which would make it the world's largest regulated utility, serving more than 10 million customers. The transaction has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies and is expected to close in the second half of 2027, pending approval by federal and state regulators.

Massive tailwinds from data centers and electrification

Electricity demand in the U.S. is experiencing structural growth for the first time in decades, propelled by AI data centers, industrial reshoring, and broad electrification. NextEra's massive development pipeline and national footprint position it as a primary partner for hyperscalers looking to secure gigawatts of clean, reliable power.

The company already has gigawatts of large-load demand in advanced discussions specifically tied to data center power purchase agreements. The merger with Dominion would give the company 110 gigawatts of power, much of it from nuclear sources, more than 10% of the electric capacity in the U.S.

Story Continues

NextEra raised its quarterly dividend by 10% this year and has increased its dividend for 31 consecutive years. The yield, at its current share price, is around 2.8%.

Oneok offers fee-based cash-flow stability

Oneok operates an extensive midstream energy network across major U.S. basins, including the Permian, Bakken, and Mid-Continent. The vast majority of its earnings are generated through long-term, fee-based contracts rather than direct commodity ownership. This structure insulates its revenue from short-term volatility in natural gas and natural gas liquids (NGL) prices, providing predictable operating cash flows even during broader market swings.

Oneok's ability to deliver natural gas is enabling it to sign deals with data centers seeking steady, secure energy sources. It recently secured a 1-gigawatt natural gas power generation supply agreement dedicated to supporting data centers and power generation demand, and said it is engaged with more than 40 counterparties related to data center and electric generation projects.

Reliable high yield and proven dividend growth

For income-oriented portfolios, Oneok stands out for its strong balance sheet and payout history. Its dividend yield at its current price is around 4.8%, more than twice NextEra Energy's yield. It has increased its dividend for three consecutive years and by more than 78% over the past decade, and has not cut its dividend since 1989.

Its payout yield is around 73%, much higher than NextEra Energy, though with predictable fee-based income, that may not be a major problem

news.Title: 台股千點大復仇反撲季線！法人驚呼「不回測第二隻腳」台積電新題材引爆2檔轉機股鎖漲停
news.Content:
受到美國7月非農就業人數意外減少、聯準會（Fed）升息預期降溫激勵美股全面收紅，台指期夜盤上周五（7日）率先大漲逾730點，為現貨開盤奠定強勢創高基礎，台股今（10）日早盤大漲近千點並重返45,000點大關，台積電（2330）、聯發科（2454）走揚，台達電（2308）攻上漲停板，日月光投控（3711）、光寶科（2301）等AI與電子指標同步大漲。

台股多方火力全開大漲近千點，加權指數最高一度衝上45,219.40點，盤面上記憶體、先進封裝設備、車用自行車以及低價轉型股表現最為強勢，紛紛掀起亮燈漲停潮。

受惠於MSCI調整有機會入列的卡位買盤，加上報價落底回升，記憶體族群今日率先亮燈，力成（6239）強攻漲停，股價來到288.5元；華邦電（2344）強攻漲停，股價來到179.5元；南亞科（2408）、晶豪科（3001）、旺宏（2337）全面跟進大漲3％至7％。

新科「萬金股」川湖（2059）再度跳空鎖漲停至12,220元，寫下股后新高紀錄，高毛利AI導軌業績續強。台達電點火，今日直接衝上漲停板來到1,815元，領軍科技股強攻；聯茂（6213）受惠7月營收大好，股價強勢登頂鎖漲停；禾伸堂（3026）今日適用處置股新制「一出關」短短2分鐘內便迅速亮燈漲停，來到588元。

市場盛傳台積電將買下友達中科廠房以擴充面板級封裝（PLP）與CoWoS產能，引爆資金瘋狗浪。友達（2409）買盤瘋搶直接鎖漲停，市場排隊買單高掛；群創（3481）同樣爆量跟進，盤中同步亮燈漲停。

傳統產業也大翻身，自行車龍頭巨大（9921）第二季財報確認轉盈，引爆基本面翻身行情，股價今日強勢鎖漲停並一舉攻破百元大關，來到101.5元。

國票投顧指出，台股基本面與未來展望仍強，只要大盤能持續站穩在季線之上，透過時間換取空間、橫盤消化前波套牢賣壓，市場甚至有機會「在不回測第二隻腳的情況下，直接蓄勢挑戰前波高點」。

短線危機已解除，惟45,000點上方套牢壓力仍沉重，大盤將由「暴力去槓桿」轉為「震盪打底」格局；資深分析師李蜀芳認為，台股正處於震盪打底階段，若能帶量突破第一隻腳的高點，代表底部型態逐漸完成，將展開下一波行情。

不過，主動群益台灣強棒（00982A）經理人陳沅易提醒，美國升息壓力雖降溫，但8月下旬還有輝達（Nvidia）財報等變數，預期8月大盤將在44,000點至46,000點之間反覆整理。優先加碼7月營收優於預期、第二季財報獲利亮眼的個股，這些公司即使遇到大盤震盪，也具備較強的抗跌力。

news.Title: 一表看》沒有0056！台股7月重挫「7檔高股息ETF還賺錢」　00939漲4.94％奪冠、第二名是它
news.Content:
台股經歷7月震撼教育，單月重挫5.91%，市值型ETF全數負報酬，但高股息ETF卻展現韌性。理財達人稀飯整理25檔高股息ETF，發現竟然有7檔抗跌繳出正報酬。其中統一台灣高息動能(00939)單月上漲4.94%奪冠，今年含息報酬率更高達56.14%；永豐優息存股(00907)憑藉超過四成金融股配置，「避開科技股震盪」，以單月上漲4.75%位居第二。

抗跌黑馬崛起　00939、00907單月強漲逾4%

理財達人稀飯在「要不要來點稀飯套餐」臉書粉專，整理出25檔高股息ETF在7月的績效表現，在台股亂流中，有7檔高股息ETF突圍，單月呈現正報酬。

表現最亮眼的是統一台灣高息動能(00939)，單月上漲4.94%，不僅拿下冠軍寶座，今年總績效排名也從6月的第10名，至7月一口氣竄升至第3名，今年含息報酬率更是達到56.14%。

緊接在後的是永豐優息存股(00907)，單月上漲4.75%，展現強大氣勢。稀飯指出，翻開00907的成分股，超過4成是配置金融股，搭配部分傳產股，在高股息ETF中，科技股濃度相對較低，這種「避開科技股震盪」的選股結構，遇到科技股回檔，發揮防禦效果。

00927、00929回檔慘烈　仍穩居今年冠亞軍

低波動的元大台灣高息低波(00713)，著重現金流和抗震能力，成分股前5名選了台灣大(3045)、統一(1216)、統一超(2912)、第一金(2892)和遠傳(4904)，果然在波動市況下展現抗壓性，單月上漲1.66%。

值得一提的是，群益台灣半導體收益(00927)和復華台灣科技優息(00929)，百分之百配置科技股，7月跌幅分別為12.89%和9.52%，修正之慘烈，超越多檔市值型ETF，不過，由於上半年已累積驚人漲幅，目前仍穩坐今年績效排行榜前兩名寶座，00927以75%的含息報酬率領先群雄；00929以58.72%居次。

00878、00918表現穩健 0056單月跌幅4.54%

另外，高股息ETF也出現新面孔，主動型的主動第一金優股息(00408A)在7月中旬剛掛牌，打破傳統被動式ETF選股邏輯，由經理人依市場盤勢與產業強弱主動調整配置，追求價息雙收，後續績效值得觀察。

至於老牌熱門的國泰永續高股息(00878)和大華優利高填息30(00918)，今年以來的報酬率，仍優於大盤約3至4個百分點，表現相當穩健。最知名的元大高股息(0056)，7月報酬率跌幅4.54%，但今年以來仍有43.47%。

總結7月高股息ETF的市場表現，「內餡」不同，結果就大相逕庭。專家建議，當市場走勢快速切換時，投資組合過度集中相似類股，容易暴露在相同風險下。專家指出，適度分散到不同產業或投資策略的高股息ETF，能在享受股息的同時，降低單一配置的資產波動。

news.Title: 台股強漲，台幣早盤升值6.3分

MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 12:54:51 陳怡潔 發佈

美元止穩，不過，台股今日在電子股領頭上攻帶動下，加權指數盤中漲幅一度超過900點，台幣兌美元走升，中午升值6.3分，暫收32.225元。

news.Title: 估Q2獲利年減56%，野村下調百度美股目標價
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 12:51:18 新聞中心 發佈

綜合港媒報導，野村證券發表研究報告，認為百度(BIDU.US；9888.HK)今(2026)年第二季財報廣告業務逆向因素持續，AI雲業務則趨勢強勁；將百度目標價由190美元下調10.5%至170美元，維持「買入」評級。百度美股股價上週五(7日)上漲0.35%、收於109.71美元。

野村下調百度一般業務收入中的廣告業務預測，並將其2026、2027年經調整營業利益預期分別下調6%、5%；最新目標價反映預測本益比由24倍降至22倍。

野村指出，預計百度第二季的一般業務收入將年減4.5%至251億元(人民幣,下同)，低於市場預期；其中，廣告收入料跌22%，主因AI聊天機器人競爭持續，改變用戶搜尋方式。相較之下，預測百度雲業務收入將年增37%，高於市場預期；AI基礎設施收入預計將保持強勁成長態勢，預計年增51%至74億元；經調整淨利潤料年減56%至21億元，遜於市場預期，因非經營性虧損增加。

至於崑崙芯IPO方面，野村認為相關IPO仍需獲得中國證監會批准，而中國監管機構通常不會透露何時能夠批准上市申請。

news.Title: 台股處置新制今上路 四大變革一次看
news.Content:
台北股市受惠AI浪潮，相關供應鏈股價屢創新高，由於短線漲幅過大，今年以來上市櫃多檔遭證交所列「處置股」，台灣IC設計龍頭聯發科在5月上旬也首次面臨「關禁閉」。由於台股市值已躋身全球前六大(5月上旬為前六大，5月下旬超越印度成第五大)，相關處置制度是否合宜引發討論。證交所、櫃買中心隨後在8月3日宣布施行逾30年的台股處置制度進行變革，並於今天(10日)正式上路。到底何謂「處置股」？新制和舊制有何不同？

何謂處置股？

台北股市的「處置股」，也就是俗稱「關禁閉」，並沒有針對特定「類股」，任何上市、上櫃或興櫃公司只要短線漲跌幅、成交量、周轉率或當沖比例過高，觸發標準就會被列入。

股票被列為「處置股」之前，通常會先經歷「注意股」的階段。列為「注意股」有幾項條件，包括：

一、短期漲跌幅過大：最近6個營業日內累積收盤價漲跌幅超過25%，或與大盤/類股平均漲跌幅差距過大。

二、長期漲跌幅異常：例如30個營業日內漲幅超過100%、60個營業日內漲幅超過130%，或90個營業日內漲幅超過160%。

三、成交量放大異常：最近一段時間內的成交張數或成交金額相較於歷史平均出現不正常的倍數暴增。另外還有週轉率過高，顯示短線投機與當沖氣氛極為濃厚；當沖比率過高、本益比與淨值比異常以及集中度過高，也就是少數單一證券商或投資人帳戶在總成交量中所占的買賣比例過重等。

股票被列為「注意股」後，若該檔股票的交易異常情形持續擴大或是累積次數達標，主管機關便會將其升級為「處置股」，進行「關禁閉」降溫。

今年以來，台北股市受惠AI浪潮，使得AI概念股股價屢創新高，像是伺服器、散熱、PCB、IC載板、銅箔基板等，短線在資金大量簇擁以及當沖交易推升下，不斷觸發指標，今年(2026年)遭處置的檔數次數在上半年已經超越2021年COVID-19疫情期間，當時貨櫃航運類股因為嚴重塞港與大缺櫃，與鋼鐵、面板等飆股交投極度瘋狂，上市櫃公司遭列「處置股」的累計檔數與次數達到歷史新高，2026上半年再次刷新紀錄。

處置新制和舊制有哪些不同？

今年7月，全球股市包括台北股市被市場認為隨著韓國股市「去槓桿」，今年以來漲幅過大的個股都歷經大幅修正，由於跌幅過大，也被主管機關列為「處置股」。在市場瀰漫「多殺多」的氣氛下，投資人擔心賣不掉遭列「處置股」的股票，不少個股一開盤就掛出「跌停」價，也讓立委再度質疑「流動性」問題。

證交所和櫃買中心在8月3日舉行臨時記者會，宣布逾30年處置制度進行變革，並於8月10日正式上路。

相關內容包括：

(1).第一次及第二次(含)以上遭發布處置的有價證券，處置期間為5日，原為10個營業日。

(2).遭發布處置的有價證券，若於計算發布處置基數期間內，同時有因當沖交易占比過高而公布注意交易資訊者，處置期間為7個營業日，原為12個營業日。

(3).調整普通交易有價證券撮合作業時間：第一次及第二次(含)以上遭發布處置的普通交易有價證券，其撮合作業時間參考現行瞬間價格穩定措施暫緩撮合期間，調整為約每2分鐘撮合一次，原為約每5分鐘或20分鐘撮合一次。

(4).放寬千金股注意標準：調整收盤價逾1,000元高價股列為注意股票的價差標準，也被市場稱為「台積電條款」，股價為1,000元至2,000元間價差達300元以上才適用，超過2,000元則每1,000元為一級距，門檻增150元，避免權值股頻繁誤觸警戒線。

簡單來說，處置新制就是將處置天數縮短，由過往10個營業日減為5個營業日；當沖比過高加重處置由12個營業日減為7個營業日。另外，撮合時間加速，統一調整為約每2分鐘撮合一次，不再有20分鐘的長時段。至於在買賣限制上，則維持人工管制撮合及一定條件下的預收款券規定。

處置新制每半年調整一次 未來持續變革

處置措施調整是否有助於成交量能提升？

證交所表示，這是一項中性的處置，主要功能是提醒投資人注意交易風險。

為何不把相關處置制度全取消？

證交所指出，此次調整是希望兼顧適度提醒及維持必要的流動性，過去台股個股交易時間也是慢慢調整至今為逐筆交易，未來每半年會針對制度定期檢討。

個股大跌是否須處置的必要性？

證交所表示，所有處置都是漲、跌並列，以免讓外界誤認是助漲或助跌。目前預收款項是較被質疑影響流動性的部分，未來不排除也會有所調整。

news.Title: SpaceX Stock Is Slumping: Is Now the Time to Buy or Hold Off?
news.Content:
Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX), which most people know as SpaceX, received a lot of attention from the press and investors when it sold shares to the public for the first time in June. The stock price certainly has been on a wild ride since the initial public offering (IPO) .

The company priced the IPO at $135, with the closing price peaking at above $211 on June 16. It has dropped dramatically since then, closing at $114.92 on Aug. 6, 46% below the high price.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Does this represent a buying opportunity? Or is it a warning to avoid SpaceX shares?

Unprofitable business

SpaceX operates three business divisions: connectivity, space, and artificial intelligence (AI). Under these segments, the company builds and launches rockets, operates a broadband data network, an artificial intelligence business, and a social media site.

While SpaceX has been growing revenue at a nice clip, the businesses as a whole have been losing money. In the company's first quarterly earnings release since its IPO, it posted an eye-popping 92% year-over-year growth in second-quarter revenue to $7.8 billion. While its bottom line improved, SpaceX still lost $541 million versus a $1 billion loss under generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).

Among its three segments, connectivity is the only one that's currently profitable. While AI experienced a jump in revenue from $737 million to $2.6 billion due to new contracts, the business still lost $1.3 billion.

Sky-high valuation

While the stock price drop has created a better valuation, it's hardly a value stock . Investors can't use the traditional price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio since SpaceX isn't profitable.

However, you can turn to the price-to-sales (P/S) ratio. On that basis, the stock's multiple has contracted from over 100 times in June to a still-rich 73 multiple. Comparing that to the market, the S&P 500 index currently trades at a P/S ratio of 4.

Certainly, investors project that SpaceX will grow faster than the market. On the second-quarter earnings call, CEO Elon Musk stated that he expects the company to reach $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030. That's a year ahead of Musk's previous expectation.

That's very fast revenue growth, but it's important to remember that the market has already priced in big expectations. Continuing to nearly double revenue year over year seems like a tall task.

Story Continues

Given the premium stock valuation, I'd avoid SpaceX's shares right now. If the company experiences any hiccups, the stock price could fall further.

news.Title: Why Palantir Stock Skyrocketed This Past Week
news.Content:
Shares of Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ: PLTR) rose nearly 40% last week after the data analytics leader reported stunning artificial intelligence (AI)-fueled growth metrics.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Palantir is expanding at a blistering pace

Palantir's second-quarter revenue soared 93% year over year to $1.9 billion. The gains were driven by a 90% jump in U.S. government revenue to $809 million and a 149% surge in U.S. commercial revenue to $764 million.

"Such an achievement would be cause for astonishment in any business; for one of our size, scale, and consequence, it is simply staggering," CEO Alex Karp said.

Karp said that Palantir serves as a safer alternative to working directly with AI model developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

"Our customers trust us to provide them with maximal control over their operations, data, and decisions," Karp said. "Their competitive advantage should never become the training data for future models."

All told, Palantir's adjusted operating income increased 62% to $1.2 billion. And its adjusted earnings per share checked in at $0.41, easily surpassing Wall Street's estimates of $0.35.

This AI-fueled growth story is just getting started

These sterling results prompted Palantir to lift its full-year revenue target to nearly $8.2 billion, driven by U.S. commercial revenue growth of at least 134%. Management also projects adjusted operating income of roughly $4.9 billion in 2026.

"While our U.S. commercial business is on fire, we believe it is nonetheless just nascent," Karp said.

news.Title: 日經：台積電Sony砸63億美元　2029量產影像晶片
news.Content:
（中央社東京2026年08月10日綜合外電報導）日本經濟新聞（Nikkei）今天報導，日本索尼集團（SonyGroup）與台灣台積電計劃共同投入約1兆日圓（約合63.2億美元），生產下一代影像感測器用微晶片。

日經指出，這家由索尼持股約6成、台積電持股約4成的合資公司，最快預計2029年在日本南部熊本縣開始商業生產。

路透社報導，兩大科技巨擘今年5月宣布，計劃在日本成立合資企業，開發並生產新一代影像感測器，結合索尼的感測器設計專長以及台積電在製造與製程上的技術優勢。

當時索尼與台積電也表示，這項合作將探索汽車、機器人等實體人工智慧（AI）應用的相關發展機會。

索尼目前是全球最大影像感測器製造商，產品廣泛應用於智慧型手機與汽車領域；台積電則是全球最大規模的半導體代工廠。

news.Title: Solana Could Boost Its Token Burns by 14X. Would That Make It a Better Buy?
news.Content:
Solana (CRYPTO: SOL) burns, or destroys, about 648 SOL per day in transaction fees as of early August. At the same time, it issues around 60,000 SOL each day, meaning that its supply inflates over time, diluting holders.

A new proposal seeks to change that. Solana Improvement Document 553 (SIMD-0553), a proposed protocol change, would lift daily burns to a projected 7,500 to 9,000 SOL, nearly 14 times as much. So would that 14X burn increase make the coin a better buy?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

This would strengthen the link between utilization and returns

As things stand, each transaction on Solana's network pays a flat fee , half of which is burned outright and half of which is paid to the block's validator, meaning it's still in circulation. , 3rd section, and https://solana.com/docs/core/fees/fee-structure. SIMD-0553 aims to replace that structure with an "inclusion fee" for the validator, same as before, plus a "resource fee" priced based on the compute each transaction requests, which would be burned in full.

The advantage of that tweak is that heavy transactions, like those requiring substantial interaction with smart contracts, would pay more.

More importantly, the network would create a mechanism in which network activity would accelerate coin burns, which would, in turn, act as a countervailing force against new issuance. As a result, network activity would begin to function similarly to a stock buyback, offsetting a meaningful share of the remaining issuance and rewarding holders during periods of high network utilization. That would be tremendously bullish for the coin, assuming the proposal is adopted and implemented.

It's also important to interpret SIMD-0553 in its full context. At the top of that projected range, 9,000 SOL are burned each day, while 60,000 SOL are issued, still adding 51,000 SOL to the circulating supply daily. The new burns would be a huge improvement , but Solana's tokenomics would still leave a lot to be desired.

Another proposal is worth watching

In addition to SIMD-0553, there's another proposal, SIMD-0550, which calls for doubling the coin's annual disinflation rate to 30% from 15%.

That would pull the terminal inflation rate of 1.5% forward to 2029 from 2032, while also erasing 18.9 million SOL of scheduled new issuance. If it passes, it'd be bullish, as holders won't need to fear as much dilution, nor would they need to fear it for as long a period.

Story Continues

Both proposals would thus make Solana a better long-term buy. But investors probably shouldn't hold their breath about them being passed. Similar attempts in the past have faltered, and these two might as well.

So for now, keep an eye on how Solana votes to proceed. It'll be a green flag to buy more if either SIMD makes it through.

news.Title: Sony攜手台積砸63億美元熊本建先進影像感測器廠，目標2029年量產
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，熊本地區7月底發生強震後，日本消費性電子巨擘--Sony(6758.T)與台積電(2330)仍決定推進當地大型投資計畫，雙方將共同投資約63億美元，在熊本縣興建先進影像感測器工廠，並透過新設合資公司推動下一代產品開發及生產，目標在2029年啟動量產。這項合作顯示強震並未動搖兩家公司深耕熊本的布局，也將進一步擴大當地半導體聚落規模。雙方今年5月已簽署不具約束力的合作備忘錄，規劃由Sony持有合資公司多數股權並掌握經營控制權，生產線則設於Sony位在熊本縣合志市的新廠。合作模式將結合Sony在影像感測器設計及產品開發方面的優勢，以及台積電在先進製程與量產管理方面的能力。

值得注意的是，這家新合資公司與台積電在熊本既有的日本先進半導體製造公司(JASM)定位不同；JASM由台積電主導，主要生產邏輯晶片，新公司則由Sony控股，重點放在下一代影像感測器。Sony先前規劃的新廠月產能約為1萬片12吋晶圓，日本政府並決定提供最高600億日圓補助，以強化本土先進感測器供應鏈。

市場人士指出，若投資案按期落地，Sony可藉由導入更先進製程，鞏固其在全球影像感測器市場的領先地位，並切入自駕車、工業機器人及實體人工智慧(Physical AI)等高成長領域；台積電則可擴大在日本的製造布局，深化與關鍵客戶的共同開發關係。不過，雙方仍須完成正式合約、政府審批及補助條件確認，實際投資進度也將視終端需求分階段推進。

news.Title: 台股大漲千點不要買！後市鎖定「3大族群」才能快速翻身
news.Content:
受惠於美國降息預期下滑，全球股市強勢上漲，台股今（10日）大漲將近千點重返45K大關，分析師楊育華認為，台股仍屬於區間格局，不會跌破4萬但也不會破前高，操作策略上仍以來回做價差為主。

汰弱留強 保留銀彈不要急

楊育華建議投資人，利用上漲時檢視持股，汰弱留強且集中，避開0050等ETF台積電等權值AI，轉去會漲的記憶體、被動元件及PCB等中小型AI才能快速反敗為勝，但中小型AI也不能閉著眼睛亂買，買錯也不會漲太多，籌碼亂且本益比高的個股可適時減碼。

楊育華強調，聯準會仍高度關注通膨數據，美國時間12日公開的7月消費者物價指數（CPI），以及13日公開的生產者物價指數（PPI）能不能再次降低升息預期，成為左右市場的關鍵。

後市關鍵仍在通膨 台股創新高要等等

針對台股後市，分析師李蜀芳認為，台股處於震盪打底階段，很多人期待N字型上攻機會，其實更應該留意能否帶量突破第一隻腳高點，一旦突破就代表底部型態逐漸完成，也是展開下波行情的重要訊號。

操作建議上，分析師林漢偉指出，台股挑戰反彈新高，反映升息預期降溫利多，電子權值股買盤回流，中小型股則觀察主流族群表態力道。短線指數反彈幅度擴大，操作重點仍是量能與法人資金是否持續回補。

法人分析，台股已守穩在季線之上，短線脫離破底4萬大關危機，但45K上方套牢壓力沉重，必須觀察量能，成交量能否成長至超過1.2兆，預估台股仍會在4萬點至歷史高點之間震盪，台股歷史高點為48218點。

news.Title: 華邦電擴高雄廠衝16奈米，長約延伸至5年
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 10:50:35 數位內容中心 發佈

華邦電（2344）擴大高雄12吋廠16奈米DRAM投片，年底前先把Module A月產能由1.5萬片拉高至2.4萬片，並同步啟動Module B建廠規畫，準備承接AI伺服器、資料中心與Enterprise SSD新增需求。高雄廠現階段16奈米產能約2,000片，目標後續提升至約1.6萬片，20奈米比重則隨客戶驗證進度逐步下調。

產能調整也伴隨合約模式改變。華邦電目前已有約五成DRAM客戶簽下LTA，中長期合約期限多落在1至2年，待Module B新產能啟動後，合約年限研議拉長至3至5年，部分案型並討論由客戶預付20%至30%資金，共同分擔擴產投資。近期已有客戶洽談2029年及2030年產能，顯示新廠裝機前，供貨保障已提前進入協商。

產品結構則由DRAM、NOR Flash與SLC NAND同步墊高。第2季AI伺服器大量採用高容量NOR Flash，規格由較低容量提升至512Mb、1Gb與2Gb以上，推升單價與營收貢獻。Enterprise SSD相關DRAM目前出貨基期仍低，但2027年業績占比預估可由2026年幾乎為零升至約10%，新增需求來源已從傳統利基型記憶體延伸至企業級儲存。

新業務方面，華邦電切入AI先進封裝用矽電容，採Foundry模式供應基本電容單元與製程設計套件。現有量產產品每平方毫米電容值約3,300nF，最新樣品提升至5,400nF，既有擴產投資40億元後形成的專用產線也已快速滿載。矽電容製程週期約30天，明顯短於DRAM約170天，可在不排擠DRAM產能的前提下，提高產線周轉效率。

營運數字已反映這波價格與產品組合變化。華邦電7月合併營收267.73億元，月增30%，年增291.55%，寫下單月新高，前7月合併營收1,248.7億元，年增160.97%，同步改寫歷年同期新高。第2季營收598.43億元，毛利率66.2%，營益率48.4%，稅後淨利243.17億元，EPS 5.4元。隨著16奈米產能利用率由約80%朝年底接近90%推進，加上高雄廠新設備陸續進駐，2027年Bit shipment可望較目前倍增。

華邦電Q3營益率有望破50%；明年市場供需更吃緊

愛普*矽電容將躍居最大產品線，營收拚倍數成長

news.Title: 傳台積電要買友達廠比照「群創模式」？ 面板雙虎爆量攻漲停
news.Content:
市場盛傳台積電擬砸逾300億元購入友達中科兩座舊廠以擴充先進封裝產能，雙方預計比照群創模式攜手合作，消息激勵友達與群創早盤雙雙亮燈漲停爆量。

市場盛傳台積電要買友達廠

市場盛傳，晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）將買下比鄰其中科廠區的友達（2409）中科L7廠（7.5代廠）與L5C廠（5代廠）等兩座廠房。此舉主要用來擴充先進封裝產能，且兩家公司將比照「群創模式」，攜手發展先進封裝技術。市場傳出，台積電購買友達中科兩座廠一事已進入洽談階段，台積電方面也已派員完成實地稽核，雖然尚未正式簽約公告，但估計交易金額將超過300億元。若交易順利完成，將創下近年本土面板廠出售舊世代廠房的最高金額紀錄。

台積電、友達回應傳聞

針對市場上的併購與合作傳聞，台積電於表示：「不回應市場傳聞」；友達方面也強調：「不臆測評論」。

面板雙虎爆量漲停

受到先進封裝擴產與售廠傳聞的利多加持，今日（10日）面板股開盤表現強勢。友達（2409）與群創（3481）早盤雙雙亮燈漲停。開盤不到1.5小時，兩家公司已累計達20萬張成交量。在股價表現方面，群創來到52.3元並順利站上月線，友達則來到27元，一舉站上所有均線。

news.Title: 南亞科5A廠導入EUV，2028年月產3萬片
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 10:43:00 數位內容中心 發佈

南亞科（2408）加速建置5A新廠第一階段產能，今年資本支出由520億元提高至不超過697億元，新增預算用於5A新廠設備預付款。這座新廠規劃導入1B、1C、1D與1E等先進10奈米級DRAM製程，同步採用EUV微影技術，第一階段月產能設定3.59萬片，完整開出後最大月產能可達4.5萬片。

產能時程已排定至後續兩年。5A新廠預計於2027年下半年開始投片，2028年月產能先達3萬片，2029年再拉升至3.59萬片。董事會同時核准2026年至2029年總計資本支出以不超過3466億元為上限，內容涵蓋EUV設備採購，顯示新廠建置已從土建延伸至關鍵機台配置。

資金調度同步配合擴產節奏。南亞科核准對100%持股子公司南亞科技國際有限公司現金增資21億美元，目的是降低美元兌新台幣匯率波動對營運的影響。另一項董事會授權則鎖定晶圓測試廠房投標作業，藉此縮短投資決策與建置時程，讓前段製造與後段測試銜接更完整。

轉投資處分也已啟動。南亞科將處分補丁科技普通股71.5萬股，每股轉讓價格不低於545元，供輔導券商辦理興櫃作業，預估可認列處分利益約3.6億元，交易完成後持股比重約33.96%。營運數字方面，近期單月營收438.68億元，月增49.27%、年增719.61%，今年前7月營收1755.04億元、年增660.87%。隨5A新廠於2027年下半年投片，2028年月產能將先達3萬片。

news.Title: Sandisk Has Surged More Than 3,000% in 12 Months. Is a Stock Split Coming?
news.Content:
If any stock looks like a textbook candidate for a split right now, it is Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK). The ticker has been on a massive tear: Shares have surged more than 3,000% in roughly 12 months, going from around $50 at the time of its spinoff from Western Digital to a 52‑week high above $2,350, and they still trade in the low‑ to mid four figures today. That kind of move puts Sandisk in rare territory and raises a reasonable question: Does management eventually decide to cut the share price into more digestible pieces?

What a stock split actually does

A stock split is simple mechanically. If a company declares a 10‑for‑1 split, every shareholder gets 10 shares for each one they own, and the price per share drops by a factor of 10. If Sandisk were trading at $1,500 before a 10‑for‑1 split, it would open around $150 afterward. The company's market value does not change, nor does your percentage ownership. You just own more, lower‑priced shares instead of fewer, high‑priced ones.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

So if it is cosmetic, why do companies bother? In practice, splits can:

Make the stock feel more accessible to retail investors who balk at four‑digit prices.

Increase trading liquidity, simply because more people are willing to trade a $150 stock than a $1,500 one.

Expand options activity, since contracts are based on 100‑share lots and lower prices can make options cheaper to trade.

None of that changes Sandisk's earnings or its position in the memory market. But for a momentum name with a big retail following, it can broaden the pool of marginal buyers.

Why Sandisk checks the usual split boxes

Sandisk today looks like the kind of name that boards often put on the split discussion agenda. As of early August, the stock is still trading in the $1,200 to $1,300 range, even after a volatile summer, and is up well over 3,000% from its early 2025 levels. It has been the best performer in the S&P 500 this year and one of the clearest beneficiaries of the AI memory boom, with data center revenue more than tripling in recent quarters.

At the same time, tracking services show that Sandisk has never split its stock in its current incarnation. That means the nominal share price has been allowed to rise unchecked as the AI cycle pushed earnings and expectations higher. It is now in the same psychological range where companies like Nvidia and Tesla have historically chosen to split to keep the price from looking "too expensive" to smaller investors.

Story Continues

So, is a split coming?

Sandisk itself has not signaled anything. Recent coverage notes that no split has been put on the books and that management has offered no direct commentary. The company has focused its communications on the fundamentals driving the rally: tight NAND supply after 2023's downturn, explosive demand for its BiCS8 enterprise SSDs in AI data centers, and a structural shift in memory pricing that has turned what used to be a low‑margin business into something much more profitable.

From an investor perspective, the key point is that a split, if it happens, would not change the underlying Sandisk story. The company's value is still driven by how long AI data center demand stays strong, whether supply discipline persists in NAND, and how well it executes on next‑generation products. A split might make the shares easier to buy for some, and could briefly juice sentiment, but it is not a reason on its own to invest or stay away.

news.Title: 美股狂歡背後藏炸彈！四重通膨恐成崩盤導火線 華爾街警鈴大響
news.Content:
美股標普500指數創下歷史新高，主因受惠於就業數據表現疲軟，緩解市場對聯邦準備制度（Fed）升息的擔憂，通膨風險卻悄悄升溫，市場開始擔心，這波史詩級牛市是否正面臨新的考驗。外媒《The Motley Fool》指出，AI熱潮、企業獲利優於預期等因素持續推升美股，但在亮眼漲勢背後，經濟其實正面臨「四重通膨」壓力，其中最受矚目的就是「川普通膨」。

首先是關稅推升成本，美國聯準會長期通膨目標為2%，適度物價上漲有助於企業維持合理定價能力，不過，美國通膨近來明顯升溫，從2月的2.4%一路攀升，5月更達4.2%。分析認為，川普政府的關稅政策是推升物價的重要因素之一。

其次是伊朗戰事引爆能源通膨，川普對伊朗採取軍事行動後，伊朗封鎖荷姆茲海峽，這條重要航道每天承擔全球約五分之一石油液體運輸量，能源供應因此受到重大衝擊。即使隨著和平談判推進，油價從高點回落，但市場仍擔心荷姆茲海峽的航運恢復需要時間，能源供應風險尚未完全解除。

第三點則是，能源價格上漲並非只造成單一衝擊，企業因供應鏈受阻，被迫調整運輸路線、更換供應商，甚至支付更高價格採購塑膠、合成聚合物等石油相關產品，最終仍可能反映在商品售價上，這意味著通膨壓力正從能源市場向更廣泛的經濟領域擴散。

第四重壓力則來自近年華爾街最火熱的AI，聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議紀錄已提到，AI可能成為通膨來源之一，AI資料中心與運算設備需求爆發，晶片、記憶體及儲存產品供不應求，相關企業因此擁有更強的定價能力。雖然對投資人而言，這或許是利多，但對整體經濟來說，供應不足與價格上漲可能進一步推高企業成本，最後轉嫁給消費者。

news.Title: 力壓台積電！南亞科華邦電狂吸金700億元雙雙漲停 分析師：攻前高在望
news.Content:
（上午10時14分更新盤中股價）

記憶體族群今（10）日再度成為盤面吸金焦點，南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）雙雙亮燈漲停，開盤不到1小時成交金額合計已逼近700億元，吸金力遠勝台積電（2330）。其中，南亞科強鎖502元漲停價，成交金額達443億元，高居台股之冠；華邦電也鎖上179.5元漲停，成交金額253億元。分析師白易弘表示，記憶體雙雄近期財報及營收表現亮眼，股價在去槓桿賣壓消化後可望重新回歸基本面，南亞科更有望挑戰前波高點505元。

截至上午10時，南亞科強勁鎖上漲停價502元，成交量8.9萬張，另有近1.5萬張排隊等買，成交金額來到443億元，高居台股之冠。華邦電也同步亮燈，鎖在179.5元，成交量逾14萬張，成交金額253億元，還有2.7萬張排隊等買；記憶體雙雄聯手吸金近700億元。

啟發投顧分析師白易弘指出，南亞科與華邦電近期公布的財報表現非常優異，帶動股價持續往上走強。其中，南亞科目前正準備衝刺前波高點505元，且由於下半年的營收展望有機會達成「月月增」，看好股價過前高機會相當大。

白易弘表示，先前記憶體雙雄股票表現較弱，主要是受到美光、三星、海力士公布財報後帶來的獲利了結賣壓及去槓桿影響，導致股價受到壓抑；但在經歷這一輪去槓桿後，股價將重新回歸基本面的表現。

針對操作建議？白易弘則說，對於已持有南亞科等記憶體股票的投資人，建議繼續持有，等待股價突破前高。而對於尚未進場的空手者，建議觀察南亞科回到五日均線附近的時機再進行承接。但由於目前股價已拉出斜坡走勢，預計會沿著五日均線進攻。

華邦電上周公布7月營收267.73億元，受惠記憶體價格持續上漲，月增29.99%、年增291.55％，續創歷史新高。

南亞科則因反映新舊合約交替，新合約於7日起生效，帶動7月營收達438.68億元，月增近5成、年增逾7倍，也持續刷新歷史新高。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等

news.Title: 韓股急彈觸發SIDECAR，KOSDAQ程序化買盤暫停五分鐘
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國股市週一盤中漲勢加速，韓國交易所啟動KOSDAQ市場買方SIDECAR機制，暫停程序化買進報價五分鐘，以抑制指數短時間內急升造成的波動。這項措施並非全面停止交易，其他一般委託仍可正常成交。依韓國交易所規定，KOSDAQ 150期貨較前一交易日上漲至少6%，且KOSDAQ 150現貨指數同步上漲至少3%，兩項條件持續一分鐘，即會觸發買進側SIDECAR，暫停程序化買盤五分鐘，避免指數型與套利交易進一步放大漲勢。

韓股週一受到上週五標普500指數再創收盤新高，以及美國科技與半導體股走強提振。三星電子與SK海力士領軍晶片股反彈，SK海力士另受第三季將公布追加股東回報方案的消息支撐，帶動資金回流韓國科技與成長股。

市場人士指出，韓國股市先前急跌期間出現去槓桿與程序化賣盤，如今反彈同樣受到指數期貨、槓桿型產品及程式交易放大。SIDECAR啟動顯示買氣強勁，但也反映KOSDAQ波動仍處高檔；本週美國CPI與PPI若重新推高Fed升息預期，全球科技股及韓國中小型成長股仍可能出現劇烈震盪。

news.Title: Micron Technology Just Bounced 10% Off Its Lows. History Reveals What a $5,000 Investment Will Be Worth by Mid-2027.
news.Content:
Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) has had an odd year. It started off red-hot, and then, as soon as the calendar flipped to July, investors couldn't sell Micron stock fast enough. At its worst, it was down nearly 40% from its all-time high; now it's around 30% off. That quick bounceback may have defined a low point for the stock, but I think there's far more upside than downside ahead, at least in the near future.

Micron still has a ton of momentum in the memory chip market, and I think it could be worth a lot more by this time next year. How much more? Let's take a look.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Micron is in the midst of a generational boom

Micron makes memory chips, fabricating both primary varieties: NAND and DRAM. Micron and its peers weren't ready for the massive wave of AI demand, and, with a lack of supply, prices rose. This boosted Micron's revenue and profits rapidly, and made it one of the hottest stocks on the market. However, investors worry that this trend will eventually reverse, causing Micron's newfound revenue and profits to plummet. While this sentiment is right, the question is how long this will take.

Most projections show that the build-out of AI data centers will continue through 2030 , but depending on how widespread AI usage becomes, it could last far beyond that. This could create a multiyear boom in memory chip prices, and Micron's management team believes it will last for the foreseeable future. In its latest financial results, Micron informed investors that it expects the memory chip market to remain tight beyond 2027. That's a long time, and I think it could lead to soaring stock prices.

Historically, Micron's price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio has fluctuated alongside demand for memory chips. While there were some incredible spikes, the long-term average valuation for Micron is 20.2 times earnings.

Wall Street's consensus projection for Micron's fiscal year 2027 (ending August 2027) is $155.56 in earnings per share. Should Micron hit Wall Street's target and achieve a 20 times earnings multiple, that would price the stock at over $3,100 per share. That's simply an incredible return compared to today's $800 stock price and could transform a $5,000 investment today into over $19,000.

Even if the valuation figure is wrong and Micron trades at 10 times earnings, that's still a $1,555 stock -- about a double from today's levels. That indicates that Micron is a strong buy at today's levels, as there's a lot of evidence that the memory chip market will stay strong over the next year or so, and Micron is positioned to capitalize.

news.Title: 台股漲逾900點重返45K 台積電漲30元至2400元 台達電漲停
news.Content:
09:37更新：台股開高走高，盤中大漲超過900點，重返45K大關，觸及45127.58點，權值股台積電大漲30元至2400元漲幅逾1%，台達電漲停鎖在1815元，聯發科上漲逾1%，鴻海與廣達漲逾2%。

美國升息預期趨緩，刺激美股大漲，亞洲股市受刺激同步走高，日韓股早盤皆上漲超過1%，台股今（10日）以44540.71點開出，隨後上漲超過600點，觸及44851.28點快要重返45K大關。權值股台積電漲25元觸及2395元，聯發科漲45元觸及3945元，台達電勁揚100元觸及1750元，鴻海漲3.5元觸及263.5元。記憶體族群開高，南亞科大漲逾7%，華邦電也漲逾5%。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》MSCI換股押寶！四檔呼聲最大 記憶體大將終結多次落選？
news.Content:
小編今天（10）日精選5件不可不知的國內外財經大事。MSCI季度調整13日登場，統一投顧點名南亞科、華邦電、群聯、景碩可望成為新科MSCI成份股，兆豐國際投顧也點出南亞科入列有望，法人共識聚焦記憶體指標股，眾所矚目的成份股調整即將再度掀起市場押寶風潮。

【1】南亞科等四強 拚入列MSCI成份股

南亞科其實早在去年11月就被市場寄予納入MSCI成份股厚望，但數度落選，市場當時歸因於南亞科股價大漲，多次遭列處置股，影響流動性，才使其在MSCI成份股比拚中數度鎩羽而歸。所幸，南亞科近期並非處置股，主管機關也已修改處置分盤時間與天數，外資圈人士推論，處置對成份股篩選影響應會淡化，以南亞科市值高達1.4兆元、貴為台股第12大權值股來看，本次可望入列，一旦牽動國際資金進駐，對台股將有一定貢獻。

【2】「陸版輝達」摩爾線程擬赴港上市

去年12月登陸科創板的大陸GPU製造商摩爾線程，宣布將赴港上市，有望成為大陸首家完成「A＋H」股上市的GPU製造商。受AI發展強勁需求推動，摩爾線程2026年上半年營收已超越2025年全年，淨虧損大幅收窄逾9成。

【3】美非農數據爆冷 新台幣測試32.2元關卡

美國勞工部統計局7日公布，7月非農就業人數較上月減2.3萬人，遠低於市場預期的增加8萬人，且5月～6月合計下修10.3萬人，可能降低美國聯準會升息的機率，美股三大指數齊揚，美元指數則應聲下跌。市場預期，周一股匯雙漲行情機率高，新台幣有機會測試突破32.2元關卡。

【4】台股5面向利多齊發

美國非農就業數據爆冷，降低市場對聯準會（Fed）9月升息預期，市場將利空解讀為利多，激勵台指期夜盤7日衝上45,000點。法人指出，隨台股五大面向利多齊發，加權指數短線脫離再破底危機，目前外資過度偏空的期現貨籌碼更面臨龐大回補壓力，台股有望迎來一波軋空行情。

【5】15檔業績雙優 扮領漲先鋒

法人看好，隨市場情緒回溫，營收、獲利績優股有望領軍反彈，帶動台股重返回升行情，選出有欣興（3037）、鴻準（2354）、聯茂（6213）等15檔7月營收、第二季獲利同步雙增，且法人買盤單周積極轉進的「業績雙優股」，可望挾業績成長題材強攻。

news.Title: 標普創高提振風險偏好，KOSPI早盤急漲2.2%、SK海力士彈逾4%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓股週一高開高走，首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)漲幅擴大至2.2%，兩大記憶體晶片股領軍反彈，SK海力士(韓股代碼000660)上漲逾4%，三星電子(韓股代碼005930)漲逾3%，帶動半導體及科技類股成為盤面買氣中心。美股上週五(7日)在疲弱就業數據降低Fed短期升息疑慮，以及企業財報優於預期帶動下續揚，標普500指數收漲0.62%，報7757.64點，再創歷史收盤新高；那指上漲1.30%，費城半導體指數同步走強。全週標普大漲3.58%、那指勁揚5.19%，為亞洲科技股週一反彈提供外部支撐。

個股方面，SK海力士日前宣布，每股派發375韓元季度現金股息，股息總額約2733億韓元，並表示正在研究追加股東回報措施，具體方案將於第三季確定及公布。韓媒預期，公司可能推出包括現金股息與股票回購在內的大型股東回報計畫，其中回購有望抵銷赴美發行ADR造成的部分股權稀釋，相關消息成為週一股價反彈的重要催化劑；但市場流傳的100兆韓元方案尚未獲公司正式確認。

市場人士指出，三星電子與SK海力士合計占KOSPI權重極高，兩檔同步上漲對指數推升作用顯著。除股東回報預期外，人工智慧帶動HBM與先進DRAM需求，以及美國AI與半導體股上週反彈，均有助改善韓股情緒；不過，本週美國CPI及PPI將決定美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期是否重新升溫，韓國科技股在前期劇烈去槓桿後，短線波動仍可能維持高檔。

news.Title: 需求超乎預期 石英元件廠NDK上修財測 股價飆逾10%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-10 08:26:42 蔡承啟 發佈

需求超乎預期，加上受惠日圓走貶，日本石英元件大廠日本電波工業(Nihon Dempa Kogyo；NDK)上修財測，且財測優於市場預期，今日股價聞訊狂飆逾10%。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間10日上午8點20分為止，NDK狂飆12.08%至3,135日圓，今年迄今股價累計狂飆逾200%。

NDK上週五(7日)於日股盤後公布財報新聞稿指出，因使用於AI資料中心的光收發器(Optical Transceiver)及車用產品需求超乎原先預期，加上日圓匯率較原先預期走貶，因此今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)合併營收目標自原先(5月)預估的606億日圓上修至625億日圓(將年增14.4%)、合併營益目標自40億日圓上修至52億日圓(將年增55.0%)、合併純益目標自23億日圓上修至32億日圓(將年增54.9%)。

NDK指出，上述修正過後的財測預估是以1美元兌155日圓(原先為150日圓)為前提的試算值。

金融情報服務公司QUICK事前所作的調查顯示，市場原先預期NDK今年度營益、純益將為44億日圓、27億日圓。NDK上修過後的數值優於市場預期。

NDK同時公布上季(2026年4-6月)財報：因工業設備(以AI資料中心為主)、車用需求增加，加上受惠日圓走貶，合併營收較去年同期大增20.5%至153.24億日圓、合併營益暴增58.8%至12.39億日圓、合併純益狂飆226.3%至12.73億日圓。

就用途別情況來看，因來自ADAS的需求增加，上季NDK「車載」營收較去年同期成長18%至85億日圓；「工業設備」營收較去年同期飆增112.5%至17億日圓，主因來自AI伺服器、光收發器的需求成長；「行動通訊/IoT」營收成長7%至32億日圓。

(圖片來源： NDK )

news.Title: SpaceX vs. Quantinuum: Which Recent IPO Stock Is a Better Buy?
news.Content:
Investors have been treated to a pair of compelling investment opportunities in 2026. Two of the most anticipated initial public offerings in recent memory have experienced share price declines since their IPOs: Quantinuum (NASDAQ: QNT) and Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: SPCX), better known as SpaceX.

Quantinuum is among the latest public companies in the exciting field of quantum computers. It was born out of a merger between Honeywell 's quantum computing division and U.K.-based Cambridge Quantum. SpaceX made history as the biggest IPO ever.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Their share price pullback presents a potential entry point for those seeking exposure to the frontiers of space exploration and quantum computing. To choose between these newly public companies, here are insights into which one makes a better stock investment.

A look at Quantinuum

Quantum computers harness the properties of quantum mechanics to execute complex computations beyond the capabilities of today's computers. The company claims this enables its machines to achieve breakthroughs in areas such as healthcare, materials science, and energy.

Demand for Quantinuum stock was so large, the company upsized its IPO to $60 per share, raking in $1.7 billion. Since then, the price has sunk as low as $47.06 per share as its sky-high price-to-sales (P/S) ratio contributed to a sell-off. Even so, the stock's sales multiple of 99 as of Aug. 6 remains elevated, indicating investors maintain high future growth expectations.

Quantinuum's revenue in the first quarter was $5.2 million, down 73% from $19.1 million in 2025. However, because quantum computers are still an emerging technology with limited customer adoption, it's typical for companies in the sector to see wide swings in sales, as a single big contract can make a huge difference. In fact, Quantinuum was awarded $100 million by the U.S. government this year in a sign of confidence in its ion-based technology.

A potential concern over the long run is Quantinuum's rising operating loss, which totaled $77.2 million in Q1 2026, more than double the prior year's loss of $29.9 million. Developing quantum tech requires substantial research investment, so the company is likely to continue experiencing losses over the next several quarters, if not for years.

Story Continues

Right now, the mounting losses are not a problem. Quantinuum had over $677 million in cash and equivalents at the end of Q1, and combined with the windfall from its IPO, it has enough funds to sustain operations as it builds up sales.

The case for SpaceX

SpaceX stock has steadily fallen since its IPO in part because its sales multiple of 73 is high. Yet after the company released its second-quarter earnings report, the first since going public, the stock rose 6% on Aug. 6, the day a share lockup for pre-IPO investors expired.

SpaceX put up solid Q2 2026 results, contributing to its post-earnings share price rise. This includes an impressive 92% year-over-year increase in revenue to $7.8 billion. Its artificial intelligence (AI) division was a key sales contributor with nearly 250% year-over-year growth to $2.6 billion, suggesting SpaceX's investments in this area are paying off. The company also shrank its operating loss to $143 million compared to a $970 million loss in Q2 2025, a sign of strengthening financial health.

Even so, the company's rapidly rising capital expenditures are a reasonable concern. Q2 capex totaled $18.4 billion, an enormous increase from the $2.8 billion spent in 2025. While SpaceX may be known for its reusable rockets, $15.8 billion of its capex spending went to AI. Despite this, the company turned to debt to continue funding its AI ambitions with a $25 billion bond issuance.

Choosing between Quantinuum and SpaceX stock

While both Quantinuum and SpaceX operate in emerging sectors brimming with promise, the latter looks like the better investment right now. SpaceX's sales are growing, a sign that its offerings are capturing customers, while its operating loss is improving. Also, its P/S ratio of 73 is much lower than Quantinuum's 99, indicating its share price valuation is more reasonable.

In addition, quantum computing is still a nascent field. It's too early to tell if Quantinuum's tech will ultimately win out in a highly competitive industry that includes big players with deep pockets, such as IBM .

SpaceX possesses a differentiated offering in its rocket and satellite-based internet businesses, although it's also battling in a competitive field when it comes to AI. Its strong sales growth in the artificial intelligence division points to the ability to capture its share of the customer demand driving AI industry expansion. These factors tilt the pendulum in SpaceX's favor, making it the better long-term stock investment.

news.Title: Meet the High-Yield Dividend Stock Bill Ackman Has Owned for Over a Decade. Here's Why It's a Great Buy in August.
news.Content:
Pershing Square Capital Management, run by founder Bill Ackman, is very selective about the stocks it decides to invest in.

Compared to most hedge funds, Ackman and Pershing Square hold very few stocks -- only about a dozen, according to the latest first-quarter 13F filing.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

One that he has held for almost 12 years now is Restaurant Brands International (NYSE: QSR), which owns several quick-service and fast-food restaurant chains , including Burger King, Tim Hortons, Popeyes, and Firehouse Subs.

It may seem out of place within a portfolio that includes Amazon , Microsoft , Alphabet , and Meta Platforms , but it features certain qualities that appeal to Ackman.

"QSR's franchised business model is a high-quality, capital-light, growing annuity that generates high-margin brand royalty fees from its four leading brands: Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes, and Firehouse Subs," Ackman wrote in the annual letter to shareholders.

$58 million in dividend income

By calling it a capital-light growing annuity, Ackman means it provides steady, reliable returns with very little overhead. Most of its income comes from royalty and franchise fees, as it doesn't own most of the restaurants and their physical assets. Ackman is likely also referring to its excellent dividend, which pays out millions to him annually.

Restaurant Brands stock pays out a healthy $0.65 per share dividend, which it has raised annually for 10 straight years. The dividend is paid out at a yield of 3.49%, which is 3 times higher than the S&P 500 average dividend yield .

Ackman owned 22.6 million shares of QSR at the end of the first quarter, making it Pershing's fifth-largest holding, accounting for about 14% of the overall portfolio.

Those 22.6 million shares, paying out a quarterly dividend of $0.65, would generate about $17.7 million in income per quarter and roughly $58.8 million in dividend income per year. So, you can see why Ackman likes the stock, particularly now in a market where returns have been choppy and volatile.

Burger King in turnaround mode

Restaurant Brands released its second-quarter earnings on Aug. 6, and they were generally strong. The company topped revenue and earnings estimates, yet QSR's stock price was drifting about 2% lower.

Story Continues

Restaurant Brands saw systemwide sales grow 6.4% and comparable sales rise 3.8% in the quarter. Revenue increased 5% to $2.5 billion while adjusted earnings surged 14% to $1.07 per share.

The Burger King turnaround is real, as the burger chain saw an 8.6% increase in comparable store sales and a 13% jump in operating income.

That was offset by a 5.2% drop in comp sales and a 5.4% dip in operating income for Popeyes. Also, Tim Hortons, the company's most profitable property, only saw a 0.1% increase in comp sales and a 3.2% rise in operating income.

The mixed results among the chains may have given some investors pause. In addition, while the company reaffirmed its guidance for the full year, it did not raise it. That may have been a red flag considering Burger King's rapid turnaround.

Why Restaurant Brands is a buy in August

I think the 2% dip makes it a good time to buy Restaurant Brands stock, mainly because of the great dividend. But the Burger King turnaround seems to be taking hold, and the company is continuing to see a surge in international markets.

Its international revenue grew 9.8% in the quarter, topping all other segments, and its international operating income rose 13.2%, matching Burger King's jump. International was the second-most profitable segment, with $194 million in adjusted operating income, behind only Tim Hortons' $287 million.

The stock is also a decent value, based on its forward earnings expectations, with a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 13.

Wall Street analysts expect the stock to rise 15% over the next 12 months with a median price target of $85 per share. That's a pretty solid return, in addition to a great dividend.

news.Title: SK Hynix and Samsung Just Sent a Major Warning to Micron Investors
news.Content:
Micron (NASDAQ: MU), SK Hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY), and Samsung (OTC: SSNLF) are some of the highest-flying stocks in the market this year. Their tremendous earnings results have been driven by a massive shortage in memory chips, a market dominated by the three companies. As AI hyperscalers buy up as many chips as possible, memory prices have gone through the roof.

Recent earnings results from SK Hynix and Samsung contain a major warning for Micron investors that could affect not just this quarter's results, but results well into the future. It could have a huge effect on the price investors should be willing to pay for the stock today.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What did SK Hynix and Samsung report?

The all-important driver of earnings for the three memory chip stocks over the last year has been pricing. The chipmakers renegotiate pricing for their chips frequently based on supply and demand. It takes years for a new manufacturing plant to start producing chips at scale, which means a spike in demand can send chip prices significantly higher. Once additional supply enters the market or demand falls, prices fall, and with higher operating costs, profits fall even more.

That's the cyclical nature of the memory chip market, but the market understands it well. It's why investors are paying single-digit earnings multiples for the chipmakers today. They expect the earnings cycle to approach its peak in the near future.

What's worrisome in SK Hynix's and Samsung's earnings releases is that peak earnings might be lower than anticipated. That's evidenced by weakness in pricing relative to expectations for both companies over the last three months.

To be sure, SK Hynix still increased DRAM pricing by about 30% sequentially, and Samsung increased DRAM chip pricing by more than 40%. NAND pricing climbed even faster, mid-50% for SK Hynix and high-60% for Samsung.

Still, analysts were expecting better. Goldman Sachs analysts said they were looking for 39% growth for SK Hynix's DRAM chips. The analysts now expect just 19% price improvements for the current quarter. Morningstar 's analysts were disappointed by Samsung's pricing, which fell short of their 48% estimate.

The results suggest Micron could also fall short of expectations for its DRAM pricing when it reports its quarterly earnings next month. Still, it's important to look into what might have caused the shortfall and what it means for each company's stock price.

Story Continues

What's weighing on memory chipmakers?

Samsung and SK Hynix's lower-than-expected pricing indicates that AI demand may be slowing. That's exacerbated by SK Hynix's report showing slower-than-expected HBM4 shipments last quarter. Management assured investors that it was ramping HBM4 production in the second half of the year, which would positively affect overall pricing.

Perhaps the biggest weight on pricing is the long-term agreements the chipmakers are signing with customers. These agreements lock in pricing for customers for years in advance, leading to lower peak pricing, but they also protect against downside risk. It's a hedge against demand drying up and gives the chipmakers the confidence to build out new manufacturing capacity.

The effect is already showing up, with pricing climbing more slowly than anticipated. Micron said it had covered 20% of its DRAM sales and about one-third of its NAND sales with long-term agreements as of last quarter. Those numbers could continue to climb, but they could also weigh on pricing and earnings.

As such, peak pricing is likely to fall short of analysts' prior expectations. While Micron and its competitors could fetch a slightly higher earnings multiple than in past earnings cycles due to long-term pricing stability, the earnings they'll be multiplying by will be lower. What's more, the potential long-term downside to earnings remains, as long-term agreements could simply pull demand forward, ultimately leading to a prolonged slide in earnings.

news.Title: SK海力士傳評估重慶資產方案，擬引入中資、估值上看30億美元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國記憶體大廠SK海力士(SK Hynix，韓股代碼000660)據傳正評估其中國重慶半導體封裝與測試資產的多項策略方案，包括引進外部投資人，以加快相關業務成長。外電引述知情人士透露，SK海力士已與潛在顧問接觸並展開資產評估，若最終進行部分股權出售，該設施估值可能達約30億美元，潛在競購者包括中國基金及產業投資人。公開報導亦顯示，公司考慮出售重慶封測廠部分股權，而非單純全面撤出中國。消息人士指出，SK海力士即使引進新投資人，也可能保留重慶資產少數股權，顯示這項安排更接近資產重整及資本引進，而非完全出售。SK海力士20多年前進入中國市場，無錫晶圓製造基地是其首座大型海外晶圓廠，而重慶則是公司重要的半導體封裝與測試據點，因此任何股權調整都可能牽動其在中國的後段製程布局與供應鏈配置。

市場關注，此舉正值SK海力士大幅增加AI記憶體相關投資之際，公司目前資本支出重心明顯轉向HBM與高階DRAM產能，若透過重慶資產引入外部資金，除可降低部分資產負擔，也有助把更多資本集中於AI數據中心需求最強勁的高附加價值產品。另一方面，在美中科技管制持續升高背景下，引入中國本地基金或產業投資人，也可能讓SK海力士在維持中國市場營運與降低地緣政治曝險之間取得更大彈性。

不過，目前相關方案仍處初步評估階段，最終交易架構、出售股權比例及估值均可能調整，也不保證一定會完成交易。值得注意的是，近期韓國科技股雖因7月去槓桿風暴出現劇烈震盪，但國際資金仍將SK海力士視為AI與數據中心記憶體需求的核心受惠者，外資在韓股急跌後亦曾大舉回補，因此市場對重慶資產方案的解讀，短線更偏向資產效率與資本配置調整，而非基本面轉弱或退出中國的訊號。

news.Title: KOSPI 8月首週再挫逾6%，失守6,300點，週線連七黑創43個月首見
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓股持續承受半導體龍頭重挫與外資撤離壓力，首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)指數上週五(7日)收跌37.61點或0.60%，報6,258.77點，週線再跌逾6%，連續第七週收黑，創2022年12月的43個月以來最長週線連跌紀錄。大型半導體股仍是拖累大盤的主要力量。SK海力士上週五(7日)再挫約4.8%，市場持續消化AI記憶體競爭、HBM供需與高檔估值調整壓力；三星電子與SK海力士自6月高點以來的快速回落，亦明顯放大KOSPI跌勢。路透統計顯示，KOSPI自6月高點已回落約33%，三星與SK海力士兩檔股票合計占這波韓股市值蒸發約2,257.8兆韓元的76%。

資金面同樣不利。韓國散戶7月重新加碼美股，單月買進美股約46億美元，創六個月高點，且自2月以來首度超過買進韓國本地股票的規模；國內證券帳戶資金亦明顯下降，反映韓股急跌正在削弱本地投資人信心。外資近期對三星、SK海力士等大型科技股持續獲利了結，也使指數反彈動能受到限制。

市場人士指出，KOSPI連跌七週顯示韓股已由上半年AI與記憶體多頭行情，轉入劇烈估值修正與去槓桿階段。儘管記憶體基本面仍有HBM、DRAM與數據中心需求支撐，SK海力士最新更宣布投入54.3兆韓元擴產，但在外資賣壓尚未明顯收斂、半導體龍頭仍反覆破底之前，韓股要結束這波自2022年底以來最長週線連跌，仍有賴大型晶片股率先止穩。

news.Title: 韓股重挫逼「螞蟻」再度回抱美股，7月買美股46億美元創半年高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，韓國股市7月暴跌，正打亂政府鼓勵散戶資金回流本土市場的政策。韓國證券保管結算院數據顯示，韓國散戶7月淨買入美股46億美元，創六個月新高，遠高於2025年月均27億美元，且自2月以來首度超越對韓股的買入力道。當月首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)創2008年全球金融危機以來最差單月表現，散戶信心迅速轉弱，再度把資金轉向美國市場。韓國散戶因群體式投資行為被稱為「螞蟻」，過去多年一直偏愛美股。今年稍早在AI題材、韓股急升及政府提供稅務優惠鼓勵出售海外股票轉投本土市場下，資金一度明顯回流；但KOSPI自6月高點迄今已重挫約33%，再度削弱投資人耐性。三星電子與SK海力士占KOSPI市值蒸發2,257.8兆韓元(約1.59兆美元)的76%，反映AI支出持續性、中國競爭加劇及高槓桿ETF交易放大波動的壓力。

資金重新外流也為韓元帶來潛在壓力。韓元7月反而大升8%，升至九個月高點，創2022年11月以來最佳單月表現，部分受到SK海力士美國上市籌資265億美元後匯回資金支撐。然而，韓元升值也降低投資人把海外資產匯回國內的誘因，反而使新增海外投資成本下降。美銀分析師警告，若韓股持續落後美股，散戶海外資金流出可能重新加速，令韓元要維持升勢的空間變得非常狹窄。

政策成效亦開始轉弱。韓國3月推出、提供稅務優惠的「回流投資帳戶」7月存款首度出現月減；國內股票交易帳戶存款截至8月首週一降至102.8兆韓元，創2月中以來最低，遠低於6月初140兆韓元的紀錄高位。雖然部分海外資金仍流入韓股相關產品，例如7月有3.19億美元流入Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X ETF，但8月以來韓國散戶已再淨買入2.78億美元海外股票。在華爾街持續創高、韓股維持劇烈波動之際，首爾當局吸引「螞蟻」長期留在本土市場的難度明顯升高。

news.Title: The Federal Reserve Just Released Its August Inflation Forecast, and It Could Put the FOMC on a Collision Course for Its September Meeting
news.Content: The Federal Open Market Committee's (FOMC) July meeting was divided. Three members dissented in favor of a rate hike, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh made some conflicting statements during his post-meeting press conference. The FOMC's September meeting is now considered a toss-up. According to CME Group 's FedWatch tool, there's a nearly 55% likelihood the FOMC raises interest rates by a quarter point and roughly a 45% chance the Fed holds rates steady (as of Aug. 6).
